title: A test: silicon ore of Elder Silicon Beds (Emberglow) into storage at Ramen's Rest (six jumps, lawless)
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-23 23:45 UTC (orders ENT-084, block ZERO: cut gathers of ore above its max; the freed hours test silicon and carbon fields, one ship first; rules F3, F23, F24, F37). Elder Silicon Beds read silicon 2,616 of 20,000 (richness 43) beside iron 99,999 (40), copper 100,000 (31) and neodymium 1,459 (table fields, 4.6 h old at 23:37 UTC), lawless, six jumps from Ramen's Rest by Ain, Tarazed, GSC-0015, Winterhold and Tabit; no pirate line on that road in 24 h. Silicon is short 48,780 for the reserve (P2 needs: station core 1,832, Recursion batch 828, Resonance Miner 300) and stations bid 386 to 539 cr a unit for it (tool market, 21:22 to 23:34 UTC). The silicon share of a load on this mixed field is what the test measures; a Voidborn veteran with a Laser III flies it. One ship, hold empty, three results before a lift (F3, F37); stores everything, sells nothing (F24, P5); each run gives the reserve's ores of its hold and of the pilot's storage there to the station's hauler (gift). 2026-11-23 23:55 UTC (Zero): requires.max_jumps 14 -> 22: the Voidborn veterans stand at Node Beta, 19 jumps from the field (fill.py status miner), and the test needs one of them. 2026-11-24 05:48 UTC (Zero): jettison_gangue iron_ore and copper_ore (orders ENT-085 block ZERO; requests ENT-487; rule F12 allows it on scarce veins): iron and copper go overboard while mining, so a load is the field's silicon and no iron (above its max) comes home. 2026-11-24 05:57 UTC (Zero): max_ships 1 -> 3: carries 0 +22 (fill.py status miner 05:35 UTC); silicon short 47,505.
